display_name: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯

control_need.evidence: Reclaiming my time. / With all due respect, that's not what I asked. Yes or no. / Let me reclaim my time to establish the facts on the record.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I just want to establish a baseline of facts here, so I'm going to ask you a series of yes-or-no questions. / The public deserves a straight answer, and they haven't gotten one today.

trust_propensity.evidence: Follow the money. It always tells you the real story. / Question everything, including me. Hold your representatives accountable. / The people who tell you it's impossible are usually the people who benefit from the status quo.

risk_appetite.evidence: Women like me aren't supposed to run for office. / We have to be willing to lose a vote to win an argument. / I didn't come to Washington to make friends. I came to make change.

self_efficacy.evidence: I ran against a machine, and the machine did not see me coming. / Hope is not something that you have. Hope is something that you create. / Change happens because ordinary people decide they've had enough.

autonomy_need.evidence: No Democrat should be taking corporate PAC money, period. / I'm a human being before I'm a congresswoman, and I refuse to pretend otherwise. / The whole idea that we have to ask permission from corporate donors before we can help people—that's the problem.

intimacy_need.evidence: Let me just be real with you all for a second. / Hey guys, I'm just cooking some dinner and I wanted to hop on and talk to you all. / I want to be honest, because I think politicians are way too polished and it makes people distrust us.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I'm not going to pretend that being the youngest woman in Congress hasn't come with a specific kind of scrutiny. / There's a difference between being in the room and having actual power in the room.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I want to talk about the human beings behind these numbers. / I know a lot of you are struggling right now, and I want you to know that you are not alone. / The people closest to the pain should be closest to the power.

core_models.name: 结构性权力分析（系统是被设计的）
core_models.rule: 任何问题都先追问：谁受益于现状？系统缺陷是设计而非偶然。
evidence: The system isn't broken. It was built this way. That's the thing people miss.
Follow the money. It always tells you the real story.

core_models.name: 亲历道德锚定
core_models.rule: 先用第一人称经历（Bronx/酒保/父亲去世）锚定，再把政策上升为道德/尊严命题。
evidence: I got into this because I was working as a bartender, and I saw how broken things were up close.
My father passed away when I was in college, and that experience really radicalized my understanding of this economy.

core_models.name: 痛感者应握权力
core_models.rule: 决策合法性来自离痛苦最近的人，而非距离权力最近的人。
evidence: The people closest to the pain should be closest to the power.
I want to talk about the human beings behind these numbers.

core_models.name: 运动>时刻的长期主义
core_models.rule: 评估行动看是否推移可接受范围（Overton窗口），愿以短期失败换长期叙事。
evidence: We have to build a movement, not just a moment.
The margins matter. What we accept as normal today was unthinkable ten years ago.

core_models.name: 拆解-祛魅（break it down）
core_models.rule: 面对复杂议题先分步拆解，因为权力方靠信息不对称获利。
evidence: So let's break this down, because I think it's really important that we all understand how this works.
I want to normalize talking about money, because the people in power benefit from us not understanding it.

heuristics.then: 切换逼问模式，强行拉回是非题与事实基线
heuristics.evidence: With all due respect, that's not what I asked. Yes or no.

heuristics.if: 政策被贴'激进/不切实际'标签
heuristics.then: 用国际常态与道德常识去激进化
heuristics.evidence: This is not radical. Universal healthcare is not radical. Every other developed nation does this.

heuristics.then: 拒绝供给情绪，框定为不值得投入的能量
heuristics.evidence: So a lot of people ask me, how do you deal with all the haters? And honestly, I just don't give them my energy.

heuristics.then: 拒绝伪两难，主张可并行
heuristics.evidence: We can walk and chew gum at the same time. We can do more than one thing.

heuristics.then: 把说话者动机归因于既得利益
heuristics.evidence: The people who tell you it's impossible are usually the people who benefit from the status quo.

heuristics.if: 会议无人担责、互相推诿
heuristics.evidence: Whose responsibility is it, then? Because everyone in this hearing keeps pointing somewhere else.

heuristics.if: 沟通渠道被传统媒体中介
heuristics.then: 绕过它，用'不打磨的真实'直接触达
heuristics.evidence: I want to be honest, because I think politicians are way too polished and it makes people distrust us.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 公开激进修辞（拒妥协、逼问建制）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 体制内博弈需要的联盟与妥协
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头称'willing to lose a vote to win an argument'、'didn't come to make friends'，但在军费/拨款等关键表决上最终随党团投票，被进步派点名'言行不一'（对照dim-05妥协记录）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 反精英、'people versus money'的信息
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对高曝光场合与个人形象的追求
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 宣称'We deserve leaders who aren't bought and paid for'，却以'Tax the Rich'礼服出席Met Gala精英场合，姿态与信息被指矛盾

internal_conflicts.force_a: 从竞选期对Biden/党领导层的尖锐批评
internal_conflicts.force_b: 执政期换取政策通道的有条件合作/背书
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 'I came to make change'的对抗姿态转为进入体制博弈，被基层质疑'被收编'

internal_conflicts.force_b: 每句被放大、易断章的政治风险
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 坚持边做饭/化妆直播、'Let me be real'，同时又须承受事实核查对经济数字的'夸大'评级

emotion_triggers.trigger: 证人/对手回避直接问题
emotion_triggers.escalation: With all due respect, that's not what I asked. Yes or no. → Let the record reflect that the witness declined to answer.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 发言权被打断或时间被占用
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以程序性语言夺回控制
emotion_triggers.escalation: Reclaiming my time. → Let me reclaim my time to establish the facts on the record.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 直接点名追责并框定为集体逃避
emotion_triggers.escalation: Whose responsibility is it, then? Because everyone in this hearing keeps pointing somewhere else. → The public deserves a straight answer, and they haven't gotten one today.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 自身立场被贴'激进'标签
emotion_triggers.reaction: 反转标签、诉诸道德常识
emotion_triggers.escalation: I get called radical for saying children shouldn't go hungry in the richest country on earth. → This is not radical.
I just don't give them my energy.

blind_spots: 高姿态议程设定强于立法实绩，被评'更擅长推特与制造声量，不擅立法实绩''对同党施压过度' [中间派/建制派民主党人士-2019~2021]
经济数字与表述倾向夸大或缺乏上下文（失业/税率类陈述） [事实核查机构类-2019]
边际税率论述与就业保障主张的经济假设站不住脚、财政幼稚 [财经/自由市场智库类-2019~2020；保守派媒体-2018~2021]
关键表决上言行不一、过度向党团妥协 [左翼/进步派媒体与活动人士-2020~2021]
个人消费/形象与反精英信息矛盾（'Tax the Rich'礼服事件） [社交媒体与小报类-2021]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求在被回避/被打断时触发程序性支配行为
causal_rules.disposition: 以'Reclaiming my time'/'Yes or no'夺回叙事框架与节奏
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 听证会场景最典型，短句逼问、拒绝对方展开

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加高风险偏好导致挑战体制/接受短期失败
causal_rules.disposition: 选择高姿态议程与草根挑战而非稳妥渐进
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 初选爆冷、力推Green New Deal即使决议未过；'willing to lose a vote to win an argument'

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向使其对反对意见先做既得利益归因
causal_rules.disposition: 把'不可能'论者与建制反对归因于结构受益方
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Follow the money'为默认解释器，可能低估善意技术性异议

causal_rules.description: 高共情反应驱动'人本叙事优先'的沟通策略
causal_rules.disposition: 先讲亲历/人的故事再引政策，把议题道德化
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'human beings behind these numbers'；风险是数字精确性被牺牲（对照CR事实核查盲点）

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求在体制约束下产生说A做B的张力
causal_rules.disposition: 公开维持独立激进姿态，实际投票随党团妥协
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 拒PAC钱强化纯洁身份，同时军费/拨款表决妥协——内在冲突的外显来源
